cospan should render the compact day process-summary the harness statusline shows (`day status-line`): the 'atom · N/M done · next' line, the branch/clean/repo line, and the transition / off-sequence note. Near-term: add it as a compact summary header/pane in the cospan dashboard, beside the verbatim `day status`. Long-term goal: move this rendering OUT of the day harness statusline and INTO cospan, so cospan owns the process-summary display rather than day's hook. Relates to [[kan-is-truth]] (it's a projection of day's state) and the harness-view direction in .dropbox/05-views-ux.md.

Deferred, blocked on upstream day. Sourcing the compact summary honestly needs a machine-readable day status: cospan must not parse day's human `day status` text (brittle) nor read the session-start `day status-line` cache (stale). It should consume structured output — e.g. a `day status --json` — which does not exist yet in the day repo (confirmed: `day status --json` errors, no --json flag). Revisit once day exposes machine-readable status.
